## Cross-cutting
### auth
- `auth-managed-provider-not-custom` — Chose a managed auth provider (Auth0) over a custom auth service; rolling our own was rejected — SOC2 scope and token-rotation maintenance outweighed any flexibility gain. _(rationale · auth)_

## apps/web
### realtime
- `orders-live-updates-poll-not-websocket` — Chose 5s polling over websockets for live order updates; websockets rejected — the corp egress proxy buffers long-lived connections, breaking realtime. _(rationale · realtime)_

## libs/auth
### auth
- `auth-session-swallows-cookie-errors` — validateCookie() returns undefined (not throw) on missing/expired cookies; callers must null-check or they silently treat an expired session as logged-out. _(gotcha · auth)_
